Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning regional transportation planning organization membership.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to regional transportation planning organizationmembership; and adding new sections to chapter 47.80 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.80 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In order to qualify for state planning funds available to regionaltransportation planning organizations, a regional transportationplanning organization, containing any county with a population greaterthan three hundred thousand bordering the state of Oregon, shallprovide voting membership to all incorporated cities within the region.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.80 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each regional transportation planning organization shall ensurethat the unincorporated areas within its region are appropriatelyrepresented on all organization boards, including its executive board.The regional transportation planning organization may determine how the p. 1 SB 6738unincorporated areas within its region are to be appropriatelyrepresented on its boards.
